title: RS Encoder
source_docs: Wireless HDL Toolbox/Error Detection and Correction/RS_Encoder.md
text: 将消息编码为 RS 码字，输入 2 路、输出 3 路；{Codeword length (N)} 指定码字长度、{Message length (K)} 指定消息长度、{Source of primitive polynomial} 指定本原多项式来源、{Primitive polynomial} 指定本原多项式、{Source of B, the starting power for roots of the primitive polynomial} 指定本原多项式根的起始幂来源、{B value} 指定本原多项式根的起始幂、{Enable puncturing} 指定删余图案来源、{Puncture pattern vector} 指定删余向量，按实例取值。

params.name: Codeword length (N)
params.values: 码字长度 7 (default) | integer in the range from 7 to 65,535

params.name: Message length (K)
params.values: 消息长度 3 (default) | integer in the range from 3 to ( Codeword length (N) – 2 )

params.name: Source of primitive polynomial
params.values: 本原多项式来源 Auto (default) | Property

params.name: Primitive polynomial
params.values: 本原多项式 [1 0 1 1] (default) | binary row vector

params.name: Source of B, the starting power for roots of the primitive polynomial
params.values: 本原多项式根的起始幂来源 Auto (default) | Property

params.name: B value
params.values: 本原多项式根的起始幂 1 (default) | positive integer

params.name: Enable puncturing
params.values: 删余图案来源 off (default) | on

params.name: Puncture pattern vector
params.values: 删余向量 [1; 1; 0; 0] (default) | binary column vector
